verdict.rationale: Multiple hands-on community reports say LaunchDarkly SDKs download the project's full flag set on connection and then stream changes over server-sent events, so flag checks add no network latency. LaunchDarkly lists 13 server-side SDKs, and its Relay Proxy fans the streaming connection out to clients. One caveat: Big Segments look up membership from Redis (then cache it) rather than evaluating purely locally. missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing local in-memory evaluation in server SDKs, evidence of microsecond-level evaluation latency, documented behavior for the Big Segments exception.
